void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Page background, hero canvas, deepest surface layer — the near-black with violet undertone that defines the entire system's mood

midnight-surface.$description: Midnight Surface — Elevated surface, card backgrounds, slightly raised panels above the void canvas

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Most elevated surface, hover states, prominent UI panels — a step brighter than midnight surface; Filled button surface, deep brand surface for primary controls sitting on the void canvas

lilac-white.$description: Lilac White — Primary text, headings, icons, high-contrast UI elements — white with a lavender cast that harmonizes with the violet canvas

pearl.$description: Pearl — Pure white used sparingly for text on violet-filled elements and maximum-contrast headlines

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary body text, card labels — cool neutral with violet undertone

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, metadata, helper text, inactive controls, border lines at full opacity

steel.$description: Steel — Deepest muted text, disabled labels, dark-mode border contrast — the lowest readable neutral

mercury.$description: Mercury — Bright neutral used in dividers, subtle borders, and light-on-dark surface tints

dusk.$description: Dusk — Mid-neutral for secondary borders, inactive icon strokes, and subtle background tints

lavender-accent.$description: Lavender Accent — Brand accent — links, active icons, focus rings, gradient endpoints, highlight punctuation. The single chromatic signal in a monochrome system

iris.$description: Iris — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cosmic-gradient.$description: Cosmic Gradient — Decorative gradient running from pink #e59cff through #ba9cff to blue #9cb2ff — used only on accent text and thin highlight strokes, never as a fill

aurora.$description: Aurora — Vertical violet glow gradient used for divider lines and edge highlights — transparent at both ends, peaks at violet center

aeonikpro.$description: Display and heading typeface used exclusively for headings at 24px+ — weight 500 (medium) instead of the conventional 600–800 creates an editorial, restrained voice. The medium weight at 56–72px is the signature choice: other brands shout, Reflect whispers

inter-v.$description: Body and UI typeface for all text below headings, navigation, buttons, inputs, badges, and interface labels. Weight 400 for body, 500 for emphasized UI text and button labels
